module: Node "Vehicle Action" (`duration` behavior, category `repeat_p_duration`). Calls a vehicle action defined in its `input_actions.json` (or those of `lua/ge/extensions/core/input/actions/vehicle.json` for "allVehicles"). Input pins: `vehId`, `val` (VALUE), `inputFilter` and `angle` (hidden, 0), flows `down`, `change`, `up` to simulate onDown/onChange/onUp. The words VALUE, FILTERTYPE and ANGLE in the command are replaced by the pins.
notes: Only actions with context `vlua` (or without context) are offered.
No fallback to the player vehicle in `work`.
`loadActions` sorts with `actions[a].order`: crashes if an action has no `order` field.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores model, type, name and action.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves model, type, name and action.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Vehicle selector and list of available actions.

formatCommand.desc: Replaces VALUE, FILTERTYPE and ANGLE in the command with the pin values.

cmd.desc: Command with tokens VALUE, FILTERTYPE, ANGLE.

loadActions.desc: Loads and caches the actions of a model (`key`) from `file` (default `vehicles/<key>/input_actions.json`).

work.desc: Sends `onDown`, `onChange`, `onUp` of the action to the vehicle according to the active flow pins.
